about_the_game:
It was supposed to be a quiet night at home…
It wasn’t.

Dad is drunk, angry, and absolutely refuses to go to sleep. The family must act fast: gather items, throw them into pots, and prepare a sleeping potion before the house descends into total chaos.

But beware — Dad won’t go down without a fight.
He can collect alcohol, cause chaos, and enter a rage mode, making him faster, more aggressive, and dangerously unpredictable for the pots and the family’s progress. The house is full of interactive objects: radios, buckets of water, traps… and who knows what else Dad might use. Every move, every item, every second counts.

This 4v1 chaotic gameplay pits the family against the drunken dad in frantic, hilarious, and unpredictable encounters. The family must cooperate, strategize, and complete mini-games to advance the potion progress, while Dad uses items, traps, and his fury to stop them at all costs.

Every second matters. Every mistake can cost the game.
Will the family succeed in putting Dad to sleep? Or will a furious, chaotic dad destroy the pots before anyone can react?

🏆 WIN CONDITIONS

  • Family wins by preparing the potion and putting Dad to sleep.

  • Dad wins by destroying most of the pots and preventing the potion from being completed.

🎮 GAME FEATURES

  • Chaotic, fast-paced, and hilarious 4v1 gameplay

  • Dynamic interaction with objects in the house: radios, water buckets, alcohol

  • Dad’s rage meter, which changes the flow of the round and increases chaos

  • Mini-games based on risk, timing, and funny fails

  • Perfect party game for playing with friends

  • Humor, chaos, and unpredictable moments in every round
